title: Selected AC1021 VisualStyle extension dictionary and XRecord output
scope: Qualify one source-bound selected AC1021 VisualStyle graph, including its extension dictionaries, XRecords, and exact ACAD EED profile, for ASCII/Binary DXF output and readback.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local drawing. Author and producer are not independently authenticated. No drawing fixture or derivative is committed.

sourceGraph.visualStyleRoot: One ACAD_VISUALSTYLE edge under NOD targets the style dictionary; that dictionary has one entry for each typed VisualStyle.
sourceGraph.perVisualStyle: Each style has one non-null xDictHandle; its extensionDictionaryFlag is 0; its extension DICTIONARY has owner equal to the style handle, cloning=1, hardOwner=1, no reactors or xDictionary, and exactly one complete DWG entry keyed ACAD_XREC_ROUNDTRIP.
sourceGraph.xrecord: Each entry uniquely targets one standard fixed object type 79 XRECORD. The XRECORD owner is its extension dictionary, cloning=1, its sole reactor points back to that dictionary, it has no extension dictionary, handle-valued data, EED, appData, or opaque raw block, and it contains 252 ordered typed values.
sourceGraph.sourceFrameEvidence: All 25 extension DICTIONARY and 25 XRECORD physical standard-object frames match their typed payloads; frame types are 42 and 79 respectively.
sourceGraph.visualStyleEed: Each style has exactly three EED groups: 1001 ACAD, 1000 AcDbSavedByObjectVersion, 1070 integer 0. The source APPID table contains the unique valid ACAD record.

implementation.profile: AC1021 VisualStyle source admission now permits only either the prior no-XDictionary/no-EED profile or the witnessed paired ACAD EED plus exact XDictionary/one-XRECORD graph. Other XDictionary shapes, EED values, XRECORD layouts, raw payloads and handle references remain refused.
implementation.writer: The AC1021 VisualStyle raw DXF builder now emits the validated ACAD_XDICTIONARY hard-owner group and typed EED before the AcDbVisualStyle subclass. Existing extension-graph and standard-source snapshot checks validate dependency closure and mutation.

checks: ASCII and Binary output followed by fresh local DXF import
25 typed VisualStyles, 25 extension dictionaries, 25 XRecords and the NOD edge
VisualStyle parent, xDictionary handle, selected body fields and all three EED groups
Every selected dictionary owner and ordered key/handle edge
Every XRecord owner/reactor and all 252 ordered values by group code, type and value
Mutated source XRecord refusal preserves the pre-existing destination sentinel
Restored source graph succeeds on the same writer and reads back

limits: This is a selected graph, not conversion of the full source drawing; the full source still stops at independent DBCOLOR and other document-wide gates.
The output test does not establish native VisualStyle rendering, producer-wide prevalence, LibreCAD/FreeCAD acceptance, or general XRecord/EED semantics.
The remaining 49 opaque carriers and 62 standard-object frames in the 186-frame inventory are not output-qualified by this receipt.
nextAction: Continue with a separate repeated physical source family such as SCALE or DICTIONARYVAR, preserving exact source, role, dependency, output and readback gates.
